audit_metadata.title: Independent Shadow Benchmark Reconciliation & Statistical Validation

CLAIM_01_RECEPTIVE_FIELD_LEAKAGE.description: Off-center sources at d <= 31 px leak error into central aperture via convolutional receptive field.
CLAIM_01_RECEPTIVE_FIELD_LEAKAGE.basis: Verified by autograd gradient calculation on AstroVisionAutoencoderV3 and controlled off-center injection experiments (Task 4.14).

CLAIM_02_MASKING_NEUTRALIZES_OFFCENTER_L.description: Masking confirmed off-center catalog stars drops central peak chi2 below threshold.
CLAIM_02_MASKING_NEUTRALIZES_OFFCENTER_L.basis: Verified in controlled off-center injection experiment with 64.4% false alarm suppression at 2px dilation.

CLAIM_03_CENTRAL_SIGNAL_PRESERVATION.description: Central aperture protection (r <= 2.5 px) preserves 100% of detected central anomalies at 2px dilation.
CLAIM_03_CENTRAL_SIGNAL_PRESERVATION.basis: Verified across 500 point injections and 500 extended injections; 0 genuine candidates lost; 0.00% central encroachment.

CLAIM_04_UN_AUGMENTED_PILOT_FPR_REDUCTIO.description: Un-augmented pilot catalog overlays suppress 29 false alarms on the 500 null controls.
CLAIM_04_UN_AUGMENTED_PILOT_FPR_REDUCTIO.basis: Existing pilot catalogues only cover 61/500 controls (12.2%) and 7/45 false positives. The 29-suppression figure was modeled from the Task 4.14 off-center injection experiment rather than un-augmented catalog overlays.

CLAIM_05_D1_AUROC_AND_D4_AUROC_BASELINES.description: D1 baseline AUROC is 0.7712 and D4 baseline AUROC is 0.8028.
CLAIM_05_D1_AUROC_AND_D4_AUROC_BASELINES.basis: Ground-truth recalculated from astrovision_v3_evaluation_trial_results.csv is D1 AUROC = 0.7745 and D4 AUROC = 0.7261. D4 AUROC of 0.8028 in Task 4.15 was a transcription discrepancy.
